coaching.headline: Drongo scored nine of 13 kills on the duo lane, and with zero fights won, the enemy took every Fangtooth, Orb Prime and ten structures.

flags.text: Drongo ran the damn game with the most hero damage, 47215, killing Steel six times and Murdock four.
Second Fangtooth handed over: no kill by either side in the preceding minute, and the enemy took Fangtooth.
Fought two fights a body down: Scarlett dead, drawn 1-1; Lt. Belica dead, lost 2-3.
Scarlett carried the damn offense: six kills, two on Drongo, two thirds of the allied total.

focus.title: Starve Drongo, show up for Fangtooth
focus.action: On the duo lane, Steel and Murdock wait for Scarlett before trading with Drongo, and all five allies gather at the Fangtooth pit before each spawn instead of conceding the pit.

5.8.call: Drongo killed Murdock, then Steel, in the allied half of the duo lane, an open-map fight lost 0-2. With first blood already lost, the duo resets to tower instead of trading.

25.2.call: Drongo killed Steel in the enemy half of the duo lane, then Neon in the allied half; Iggy & Scorch then razed the allied offlane inner. With the enemy mid outer already down, Lt. Belica and Scarlett rotate to the duo lane to meet Drongo with numbers.

31.7.call: Scarlett killed Mourn in the allied jungle, yet Orb Prime still went to the enemy, and four allies then died at the Prime pit before the Core fell. With three inhibitors down, defend the base instead.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Four of the Drongo deaths came on the duo lane, four after Forticus was finished. When Drongo is in range, hold Shield Slam until Shrapnel Cannon is spent.
44% kill participation and 50414 damage mitigated, the most of all ten players, but zero enemy wards cleared. If a sentry is slotted, sweep the Fangtooth approach before each spawn.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Took the enemy mid outer, the allies' only tower, on 10.7 CS per minute against an 8.1 norm. Once an enemy outer falls, call Scarlett to the next tower.
Three of four deaths came off mid, to Drongo, Howitzer and Iggy & Scorch. With an ally already dead, hold mid rather than join the fight.
be4f275e-8540-4337-873a-0ab2e08bb6d4: Died to Mourn at the Fangtooth pit outside any detected fight, just before the first enemy Fangtooth. Enter the Fangtooth pit only with two allies alongside.
Zero assists, and two more deaths outside any detected fight in the allied half, to Howitzer on mid and Iggy & Scorch on the offlane. Ping a laner before ganking.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Gave Drongo first blood, then died twice more before minute ten, to Drongo and Narbash. Sidestep Gag Grenade's silence and trade only with Steel in front.
A death to Drongo on the duo lane outside any detected fight came before Drongo razed the allied duo inner and inhibitor. Once inhibitors fall, group with Steel.
409ee5e6-1550-4241-b62f-948cb1608458: Died off the offlane to Drongo on duo and Iggy & Scorch on mid, each followed by an offlane structure falling. Spot Iggy & Scorch before rotating.
Hero damage ran 788 per minute on a 1008 norm without a kill. In grouped fights, hold Final Thread until Steel's Shield Slam lands.

matchup: Duo against Drongo and Narbash; Drongo's Demolisher ignores 25% of physical armor, blunting an armor stack.
Narbash healed 16532, second only to Mourn in the game.
build: Forticus met the physical-armor need first: 55 physical armor and 25 tenacity, finished before Xenia and Dynamo.
Xenia shields a nearby ally on a per-target cooldown; Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take 8% more damage.
eternal: Krix scales max health with level; Regenerative Tissue heals after a pause from hero damage, Cannibalism adds health per takedown.
The support Eternal field is a toss-up between Idrisil and Nihil; Krix, by far the most played, ranks below both.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Heavy Metal adds magical damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash, scaling with total physical and magical armor.
Adaptive Force leans ahead in the support field; Heavy Metal, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush active speeds nearby allies and lets allies ignore slows; Visionary raises the ward cap.
Leafsong leans ahead in the support crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: Best all-matchup core is Xenia, Dynamo, Vanguardian at 63.6% in 66 games; Vanguardian is the missing piece.
Vanguardian next adds tenacity, a listed answer to Drongo, and gives nearby allies physical and magical armor.
Adaptive Force over Heavy Metal: two smaller Force Shield charges, lower cooldown, losing Heavy Metal's armor-scaled damage.

matchup: Lane into Howitzer runs 51.3% across 165 games; Howitzer went 5/2/4 and destroyed the allied mid inner.
23199 of 27185 hero damage taken was magical, from a four-magical enemy draft.
build: Catalytic Drive's magical armor fit that damage profile. Sound keep into magic-heavy drafts.
Hero damage ran 600 per minute on a 763 norm; Tainted Scepter, the healing cut, came last.
Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings, the most played core into Howitzer, were all built.
eternal: Aion turns spell damage on heroes into gold; Bottomless Vial adds magical power per river buff the holder kills.
Lotus is clearly the field's best midlane Eternal here; Aion ranks well down the list.
Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus is the best Aion pair.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience each second, growing with level.
Combat Veteran is clearly the field's best augment here. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer leans ahead in the midlane crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: Field buys Prophecy 35% of the time into Howitzer against a usual 27%, winning 51.6%; Prophecy was not built.
Finish Tainted Scepter before Noxia while Mourn and Narbash are both healing, giving up earlier burst.
Lotus over Aion is the field-backed swap: random stacking gains on takedowns, giving up spell gold.

matchup: Mourn died once in 32 minutes on 24805 healing; Forticus, finished late, adds a shield on taking hero damage.
Wait out Mourn's Beguile sleep before committing to a fight.
Fangtooth went 3 to 0 and Blue buff 6 to 3 for the enemy.
build: Stacked sustain: Solaris empowered hits heal, Nightfall abilities heal off hero damage; 16496 healing in all.
No magical armor into a four-magical draft; 19458 of 28044 hero damage taken was magical.
eternal: Knell shreds armor with Rust stacks on hits; Patina shields after a stretch without damage, Peal maxes Rust after the ultimate.
Knell leans ahead in the jungle field, and Patina with Peal is the best Knell pair. Sound keep.
augment: Scarlet Dawn cuts First Intent's cooldown on ability, Empowered Cindara and Third Strike hits.
The jungle augment field is a toss-up between Volcaic Slam and Coup De Grâce; Scarlet Dawn ranks third.
crest: Nex's Reap active dashes, damages nearby heroes with stored Sow added, and slows.
Judgement is the most played jungle crest here; Nex has too few games to lead.
improvement: Best all-matchup core is Vyzar Carapace, Salvation and Forticus at 54.5% in 66 games; none were built.
Swapping Imperator for a magical-armor item answers the four-magical draft, giving up crit damage.

matchup: Lane into Drongo runs 49.6% across 583 games; the Gold buff went to the enemy six times, the allies once.
Drongo finished Lightning Hawk and Vanquisher before this carry's second item, then added Demolisher and Imperator.
build: Hero damage ran 395 per minute against a 699 norm, 43% under.
Onixian Quiver fires two extra projectiles on each ranged basic attack; no armor or tenacity in the slot.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage every third consecutive hit; Serration adds missing-health damage, Melting Point hurts high-armor targets.
Thraex leans ahead in the carry field; Vermis ranks last among Eternals with enough games.
Serration with Melting Point is the best Vermis pair.
augment: Justice's Reach makes Shots Fired pierce units and reach farther.
A toss-up with Sting Operation, but Justice's Reach holds the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's Purifying Guard active cleanses all debuffs and grants a brief shield.
Pacifier is clearly the field's best carry crest here; Liberator and Pacifier both build from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: Physical armor into Drongo was not built; the most played core into Drongo is Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher, Imperator, 62.4% in 101.
Equinox, the listed tenacity answer, keeps crit and attack speed while adding a low-health shield.
Tainted Rounds over Onixian Quiver cuts healing on basic-attack hits into Mourn and Narbash.

matchup: Iggy & Scorch went 4/2/4 and destroyed the allied offlane outer and inner towers.
Mourn's items added 45 magical armor and 1075 health.
build: Caustica, finished last, ignores 35% of magical armor, a fit into Mourn's itemized magical armor.
Megacosm burns max health over time on ability damage, with extra against bonus health.
eternal: Vesh turns ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Tithe of Death pays on takedowns, Millennia grows ultimate damage.
The offlane Eternal field here is thin and a toss-up between Aion, Vesh and Lotus.
Two takedowns gave Tithe of Death little to build on.
augment: RAM stacks magical power on takedowns and loses half the stacks on death; two takedowns against four deaths starved RAM.
Ghost in the Machine is the most played offlane augment here; RAM has 24 games.
crest: Soulbearer: an active shield with magical lifesteal and speed, upgraded through Wizard Crest.
Epoch is the most played offlane crest here; Soulbearer has 26 games.
improvement: Lane into Iggy & Scorch records 49.5% across 183 games, with no field core listed for the matchup.
Wraith Leggings, in the field core, adds 12% magical ability damage against heroes under 40% health.
Ghost in the Machine over RAM trades takedown stacking for brief invisibility after an Erase Vector dash.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback), Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash, Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
ourKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

ourKits.combo: Cast basic abilities to build 3 Thread, then Overclock Data Burst to slow and Mesmerize, follow with L.I.N.X true damage and an Erase Vector dash into the exploding Jolt; Final Thread Overclocks everything and its recast bomb finishes low targets.
ourKits.winCondition: Chunk enemies with Overclocked abilities in lane and teamfights, then use Final Thread to chain several Overclocked casts and execute with the bomb.
ourKits.passive: Neural Network: every 3 basic ability casts Overclock her next basic ability for an extra effect.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners or engage supports who keep enemies in Data Burst range and give her time to cycle Thread.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch her Thread count and respect the next ability when she is at 3, since Overclocked Data Burst Mesmerizes. Dodge the lobbed Data Burst before it detonates, and engage after Erase Vector is spent, which is her only dash. Magic armor helps but L.I.N.X return and pulse are true damage.

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
enemyKits.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
enemyKits.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
enemyKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
enemyKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
enemyKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

enemyKits.combo: H11 Cluster Grenades and Land Mine to slow and stun, R2000 Missile charged for full damage, then Make It Rain on the held enemies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Lock down space with grenades and mines and rain missiles on enemies stuck in them.
enemyKits.passive: Armed Salvo empowers his next basic with area damage that restores mana, and each ability cast shortens its cooldown.
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokepoints that force enemies into his zones.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Walk around grenades and get out of Land Mine's blast before it goes off. He can blast himself away with Land Mine, so engage after it is used; magical armor helps against his burst.

enemyKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
enemyKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
enemyKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
enemyKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
enemyKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,475 hero damage a minute, more than 91% of Drongo carry players this patch (34% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Imperator.
Drongo dealt 47,215 hero damage, 34% of their team's, with +215 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Steel (level 17 estimated: about 229 physical armor, 159 after penetration) and Murdock (level 17 estimated: about 110 physical armor, 70 after penetration) that is about 27% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.

Lesson: Drongo's penetration cut through: Steel took about 27% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 229, about 159 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Demolisher.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Drongo killed built physical armor (Steel). Anti-heal on Lt. Belica. We killed Drongo 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Drongo carry games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

evidence: Drongo 13/3/3, 52% of their kills, 47215 hero damage (the most in the game).
Killed Steel 6, Murdock 4, Lt. Belica 1, Neon 1, Scarlett 1.
Hard CC: Gag Grenade (silence), Shrapnel Cannon (knockback).

Play against: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage
Answers: Physical armor on whoever it kept killing. Tenacity on the players it caught.

bullets: Imperator made critical strikes deal 30% more, and Wastelander turned each critical strike into a bleed for a share of the target's max health.
Xyris's bonus damage grew with units killed, Bone Collector added permanent critical chance after enough kills, and Iron Will healed Drongo off basic attacks, more on critical strikes.
Lightning Hawk built Momentum from moving and attacking, so Rad Rounds' attack speed filled Momentum faster; at 100 stacks one shot dealt extra damage and slowed 20%.
After an ability cast, Solaris empowered the next basic attack within 4s, on a short cooldown, and that hit healed Scarlett for 50% of the damage dealt.
Knell's Rust shredded hero armor, adding armor to Scarlett; Peal shortened Swan Song's cooldown and briefly maxed Rust on cast; Patina shielded Scarlett after a stretch without damage.
Nightfall made abilities heal 6% of damage dealt to heroes, while First Intent's shield grew each time the dash hit an enemy hero.
Forticus shielded Mourn on taking hero damage, on a cooldown, and briefly added max health while trading with heroes; Contagion gave Mourn and allies armor and healing.
Nihil's Doom stacked armor and power while Mourn kept damaging heroes, From the Abyss restored health in hero fights, and Terror cut damage from monsters and towers.
Extract's empowered attack restored Mourn's health on hit, and Flux Matrix made nearby enemy heroes take 10% more magical damage, boosting Contagion, Beguile and Abduct.
